DataType.Name: CONTINGENCY_DATAOUT
DataType.Content:
TYPE CONTINGENCY_DATAOUT : STRUCT (*********************************************************************************************************************** BITPACKING INFO FOR CONTINGENCY_DATA ******************************************************************************************************************************** BIT 0 : Status Status of this Contingency Good/Bad BIT 1 : Satisfied Enough load has been identified for shed BIT 2 : ENABLED This contingency is enabled BIT 3 : OPERATOR_DISABLE The contingency disable command from the HMI BIT 4 : Bad_Status Bad Status for contingency breakers ***************************************************************************************************************)
CONTINGENCY_DATA:DWORD; Name:STRING(32); (*Contingency Name*) Present_P:REAL; (* Measured kW*) Present_Q:REAL; (* Measured kW*) Current_Max_P:REAL; (* Present_P + IRM_Actual *) Available_Cap:REAL; (*Sum of Current MAX of all remaining generation *) Measured_Load:REAL; (*Sum of all Generation Present Power *) IRM_Actual:REAL; (*= Operator IRM IF Spinning reserve >Operator IRM; = Spinning reserve IF Spinning reserve <Operator IRM *) IRM_Operator:REAL; (*Step load capability of the generator set by the operator *) Load_to_Shed:REAL; (* Calculated available load to be shed *) Required_to_Shed:REAL; (* Calculated required load to be shed *) LOAD_BUS_CONN:DWORD; (*Bus that load is connected to *) Select_List: ARRAY[1..8] OF DWORD; (* List of indications identifying which loads have been selected for this contingency *) Inhibit_List: ARRAY[1..8] OF DWORD; (* List of indications identifying which loads have been inhibited for this contingency *) IRM_MAX : REAL; (*MAXMIMUM LIMIT FOR THE IRM VALUES FROM THE HMI*)
END_STRUCT END_TYPE
